raw_meta_yaml:
# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/prefix-dev/recipe-format/main/schema.json
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "8.5"

package:
  name: zope.interface
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/z/zope.interface/zope_interface-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 7a3ba1c5877f0f3e3906b02ddf793abed2becc2948116414ce0e1dd820b68d6d

build:
  number: 0
  script:
    - ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler("c") }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - python
  host:
    - pip
    - python
    - setuptools
  run:
    - python
    - setuptools

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - zope
        - zope.interface
        - zope.interface.common
        - zope.interface.common.tests
        - zope.interface.common.mapping
        - zope.interface._zope_interface_coptimizations
        - zope.interface.tests
      pip_check: true

about:
  license: ZPL-2.1
  license_file:
    - LICENSE.txt
    - COPYRIGHT.txt
  summary: Interfaces for Python
  description: |
    Provides an implementation of object interfaces for Python.Interfaces are objects
    that specify the external behavior of objects that provide them.
  homepage: https://github.com/zopefoundation/zope.interface
  documentation: https://zopeinterface.readthedocs.io

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - isuruf
    - ocefpaf
